metadata.name: Grammarly: AI Writing Assistant and Grammar Checker App
metadata.description: Improve your writing with all-in-one assistance—including generative AI, grammar check, and more.

endpoints.purpose: User account sign-in and session authentication
Core HTTP writing correction checking API
Grammarly Gnar tracking and behavior tracking system
Dynamic remote config and experiment synchronization

keys.purpose: Stores user editor preferences, custom dictionaries, and active features toggle
Stores Grammarly's Gnar tracking identifiers and user behavioral interaction timelines
Tracks the status of token authentication refresh cycles upon browser launch
Caches Remote feature treatment flags and active experiment treatment definitions

workflows.name: Real-Time Text Checking & Suggestion Injection
triggers: User inputs text into text area
Page loads and focuses edit field
steps: Content script monitors DOM inputs and intercepts text updates
Content script communicates text changes to service worker via Cheetah payload message
Service worker relays text check request over wss://capi.grammarly.com WebSocket
WebSocket server analyzes spelling, grammar, and style suggestions
Service worker receives correction suggestion payloads
Service worker emits alert counts and short form card html markup to content script
Content script injects inline highlight overlays and renders spelling/correction card UI inline

workflows.name: User Session Authentication Flow
triggers: User clicks Sign In button in Popup or Sidebar Panel
steps: Popup captures credentials or triggers OAuth 2.0 redirection flow
Sends validation details to background service worker
Service worker performs token verification checks with https://auth.grammarly.com
Service worker saves OAuth state, token values, and user subscription limits in storage
Enables Premium suggestions or specific writing settings inside active sessions

workflows.name: Usage Tracking & Event Analytics Stream
steps: Content script captures accept or ignore click events on suggestion card markup
Sends event details to service worker via actionNotification payload
Service worker logs analytics to gnarInternalStorage
Relays structured metrics data payload to gnar.grammarly.com, data.grammarly.com, and extension.femetrics.grammarly.io endpoints

privacy.minimization: Collects full text field inputs and active document contents to process and deliver real-time suggestions, but includes extensive exclusion domains (e.g., outlook, slack, gmail, github) in content scripts match filters to minimize unnecessary data leakage.
privacy.consent: Requires explicit sign-in consent to authenticate premium accounts, but collects anonymized text and gnar telemetry interactions implicitly during regular usage of writing helper functionality.
privacy.retention: Anonymized diagnostic logs and metrics are stored in local buffers (e.g., gnarInternalStorage) indefinitely, with session backups temporarily saved in local storage until sent.

third_parties.name: api.iterable.com
third_parties.purpose: Lifecycle tracking, marketing notifications, and customer engagement emails

privacy.policy_compliance: Fully documented and compliant with Chrome Web Store User Data policies, including high minimization of telemetry data. However, the transmission of user text blocks to capi servers requires clear, explicit user opt-in disclosures in high-privacy environments.

risks.justification: Transmits granular user interactions, accepted/dismissed suggestions, and telemetry timestamps continuously to gnar.grammarly.com and multiple front-end logging endpoints without explicit opt-in.
Executes dynamic code logic through JS evaluation APIs (new Function or eval) in multiple bundled scripts, which can present a vector for un-vetted script executions.
Requests broad optional permissions (nativeMessaging, clipboardRead) which are highly sensitive and should only be explicitly invoked when the absolute necessity is proven in code.

items.data_description: The actual text typed by the user inside text areas, Overleaf, or Google Docs editor canvases.
items.source: DOM input/focus/key events and Google Docs canvas rendering buffers
items.storage: unknown (temporary caches in memory, no indefinite local storage observed)
items.transmission: transmitted to wss://capi.grammarly.com and https://capi.grammarly.com for real-time suggestions
items.local_processing: text sentence segmentation, spelling error boundary extraction
items.user_control_or_consent: implicit (provided during writing action, can be toggled by disabling Grammarly on specific domain)
items.purpose_observed: grammar checks, spelling correction, and generative AI suggestions

items.data_description: User account login status, session ID, OAuth access token, and user email context.
items.collection_trigger: user manual sign-in, extension launch refresh cycle
items.storage: stored in chrome.storage.local under key gr-oauth-service-state
items.transmission: sent in request headers or cookies to Grammarly core checking and sync servers
items.local_processing: session validation checks and authorization gating
items.user_control_or_consent: explicit (provided directly during user-initiated popup sign-in or OAuth approval)
items.purpose_observed: account authorization status check and subscription plan enforcement

items.data_description: Granular click logs showing user interactions on suggestions (accepted, ignored, dismissed suggestions) and extension UI performance metrics.
items.source: DOM click event listeners and popup interaction handlers
items.collection_trigger: user clicks on suggest card buttons, telemetry timers, heartbeat logs
items.storage: stored in chrome.storage.local under key gnarInternalStorage and session_storage_logs_backup
items.transmission: sent to https://gnar.grammarly.com and https://data.grammarly.com telemetry backends
items.local_processing: telemetry bundle queueing and JSON payload formatting
items.user_control_or_consent: unknown (implied background reporting, settings can enable/disable gnar deprecation flag)
items.purpose_observed: user interaction metrics tracking and application diagnostic quality improvements

items.data_description: The domain name or exact URL of the active browser tab where Grammarly text editor interactions are occurring.
items.source: chrome.tabs API queries, active tab focus updates, content script window.location
items.collection_trigger: active tab updates, page navigation, editable area focus
items.storage: unknown (no permanent storage of URLs in local storage observed)
items.transmission: sent as headers (Referer) or parameter metadata to capi checking service and gnar telemetry tracking
items.local_processing: evaluating domain-specific exclusion and custom match filters (e.g. docs.google.com vs. blacklisted pages)
items.purpose_observed: applying custom rules, blocking checked sites, and compatibility tuning
